hook: Free! Your dog as a crayon drawing, in two sizes.
how: On a phone, tap More, then Share. On a computer, it's in the top bar.
sizes: Pick Post or Story. Your dog's name goes on only if you want.
pals: Every dog gets one, outfit and all!
moment: Or tap Share this moment after a walk, a new Bond level or a story scene.
device: It's drawn right on your device. The game uploads nothing.
ask: Share your doodle and tag us! I'm Noodle, by the way.
